name: oxideterm
description: AI-native workspace for local shells and remote machines in Rust+GPUI. Combines split-pane SSH, SFTP, remote file editing, and MCP tools with the semantic coloring and free-type input ergonomics familiar from WindTerm. Zero WebView, zero OpenSSL, zero telemetry, and no app subscription.
